So a server that starts its Claude program during its shutdown while it holds a project is seen by no test. Measured on a copy: with the fix and the M01p server, create is red at 'the trap was never started, after the stop' (FIXp); with the fix on today's page the whole file is 7 of 7 green (FIXk, 32867 ms).
